technical_and_design_decisions: Target Spring Framework 6.0+ requiring Java 17+ as the base platform.
Leverage existing Spring Integration extensions for WebSocket and AWS modules to minimize custom code.
Design a custom exception hierarchy (GlobalException, DefaultException, ModuleSpecificException) to support the error channel routing requirement.
Use Avro/Parquet formats for the HAWQ sink to integrate with PXF extensions.
Implement a configurable error channel mechanism that stages error payloads and propagates the original 'Caused by' exception.
assumptions: The developer has prior experience with Spring Integration, AWS SDK, Cassandra, HAWQ/PXF, and SOLR.
The data partition strategy state preservation feature is already implemented; U8 represents only the testing effort.
Development and testing environments (including AWS, Cassandra, HAWQ, and SOLR instances) are available and accessible.
1 workday equals 8 hours of productive development effort.
Existing CI/CD pipelines and project scaffolding are already in place.

activities.activity_description: Analyze user stories, design the module interfaces, define the exception hierarchy, and plan the integration points for the new source and sink modules.
Implement the WebSocket source module to create an interactive communication channel between the browser session and the runtime for event ingestion.
Implement the AWS source module to ingest data from Amazon S3 and integrate with the Simple Email Service (SES).
Implement the Cassandra sink module to write high volumes of variable data segments to the NoSQL database.
Implement the AWS sink module to write data directly into Amazon S3.
Implement the HAWQ sink module to write data directly into HAWQ via PXF extensions using Avro/Parquet formats.
Implement the SOLR sink module to perform full-text indexing and search through the SOLR backend server.
Implement the configurable error channel, stage error payloads, propagate 'Caused by' exceptions, and build the GlobalException, DefaultException, and ModuleSpecificException hierarchy.

activities.activity_name: Data Partition Strategy State Preservation Testing
activities.activity_description: Perform comprehensive testing of the existing data partition strategy state preservation feature to ensure modules dynamically adapt when added or deleted.
Conduct end-to-end integration testing of all new modules and error handling, and update project documentation.
